title: Autosens feature not shown in settings
symptom: When using OpenAPS AMA mode, the function 'Use Autosens feature' is not shown in the AMA settings menu. It can only be found using the search function in the settings menu.
cause: The bug is likely due to a UI issue where the option is hidden when dynamic sensitivity is enabled in SMB mode, but the thread does not explicitly state the root cause.
fix: Workaround: activate SMB algorithm, go to its settings and disable dynamic sensitivity, then go back to AMA algorithm, the option should appear. The bug is fixed in AAPS 4.0.0 via PR #5013.
evidence_quote: 1) activate SMB algorithm 2) go to its settings and disable dynamic sensitivity 3) go back to AMA algo again, you should see the option as expected.
